content.value_statement: Vague Prisma Next questions can lead to the wrong workflow. This skill identifies the user goal and routes it to the appropriate specialized skill.
actual_capabilities: Routes vague Prisma Next requests to a specialized workflow skill.
Recognizes workflows for setup, contracts, migrations, queries, runtime, builds, debugging, Supabase, and feedback.
Asks one focused question when the intended workflow is unclear.
Provides a concise overview of the Prisma Next contract-first model.
Distinguishes SQL runtime surfaces from MongoDB ORM addressing.
limitations: Does not perform specialized Prisma Next workflows itself.
Depends on the referenced sibling skills being installed and available.
Covers Prisma Next concepts described in the skill, not every Prisma product version.
Requires clarification when a request spans several workflows.

use_cases.title: Find a Starting Point
use_cases.description: Turn a broad Prisma Next question into a focused setup or orientation workflow.

use_cases.title: Select the Correct Workflow
use_cases.description: Route a concrete database task to the matching contract, migration, query, runtime, or build skill.

use_cases.title: Triage Team Questions
use_cases.description: Classify support questions before assigning specialized guidance for debugging, Supabase, or product feedback.

prompt_templates.title: Start With Prisma Next
prompt_templates.prompt: I am new to Prisma Next. Help me choose the best place to start for my project.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the user needs basic orientation.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Database Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Route this Prisma Next task to the correct workflow: [describe the task and desired result].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the task is known but the correct specialized skill is unclear.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Prisma Next
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how Prisma Next differs from [tool or Prisma version], then route my next step based on [project context].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for comparison questions followed by practical guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Triage a Complex Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Classify this Prisma Next request across contracts, migrations, queries, runtime, builds, debugging, Supabase, or feedback: [full request]. Ask one question if needed.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a request may span several workflows.

output_examples.input: I just created a Prisma Next project. What should I do now?
output_examples.output: This is a first-touch orientation request. Continue with the Prisma Next quickstart workflow.

output_examples.input: I need to add a relation and update my database.
output_examples.output: Start with the contract workflow for the relation. Then use the migrations workflow to plan and apply the database change.

output_examples.input: My deployment shows an unfamiliar Prisma Next error.
output_examples.output: This belongs in the debugging workflow. Provide the exact error code, symptom, and deployment context.

best_practices: Describe the intended outcome and current project state.
Include the database target when behavior may differ between SQL and MongoDB.
Provide exact error codes or symptoms for debugging requests.
anti_patterns: Do not use this router when the specialized workflow is already clear.
Do not combine unrelated Prisma Next tasks without identifying the primary goal.
Do not expect this skill to replace the referenced workflow skills.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It classifies Prisma Next questions and directs them to the appropriate specialized workflow.

faq.question: Can it create a Prisma Next project?
faq.answer: It routes project creation and existing database adoption to the quickstart skill.

faq.question: Can it write queries or migrations?
faq.answer: It does not perform those tasks directly. It routes them to the query or migration skill.

faq.question: Does it support MongoDB?
faq.answer: Yes. It identifies MongoDB ORM addressing as distinct from the SQL runtime surfaces.

faq.question: What happens when my request is unclear?
faq.answer: The skill asks one focused question to identify the correct workflow.

faq.question: Which AI tools support this skill?
faq.answer: The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
